claims.necessity_reason: Both versions contain a zTXt handler that accepts placement after IDAT and calls the changed decompressor. The effective feature settings and end-reading dispatch are not supplied, so the frozen behavior cannot yet be established as reachable or blocked.

before.reason: The handler supports the operation, but its build availability and png_read_end dispatch are unresolved. The harness also calls png_start_read_image after png_read_update_info; whether the resulting application error is fatal depends on an unsupplied flag state.
